title: Siman 345
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.he: בַּלַּיְלָהקדֶם הַבְּרִית מִילָה שֶׁל בְּנוֹ שְׁלֹמה אֶפְרַיִם זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה אָז יָשַׁב עִמָּנוּ הַרְבֵּה וְדִבֵּר עִמָּנוּ הַרְבֵּה מֵעִנְיַן גְּדֻלָּתוֹ וַאֲמִתַּת הַפְלָגַת מַעֲלָתוֹ וְשָׁמַעְנוּ אָז כַּמָּה דְּבָרִים. וְאָמַר אָז שֶׁקָּשֶׁה לְהַכְנִיס בַּלֵּב עִנְיַן גְּדֻלָּתוֹ, וְאִי אֶפְשָׁר
segments.en: (6.) He answered and said: "We are not at all from this world of today. And because of this the world cannot tolerate us — and leadership [meaning a head and guide] is not relevant to me at all — for no leadership is due to me in today's world. And even the little leadership I truly have — that is not leadership at all. On the contrary, it is literally a mockery and jest [chuka v'itlula]. And even that little bit that I have is only against nature — because I compelled my nature to this. And because of that it is possible for some word to come from me into the world. And all the conversations and narration...
